data.notes: Date-specific Courchevel club and festival lineups for February 2027 appear not to be published yet, while adjacent Méribel Mottaret has confirmed live après-ski and late-night music listings.

events.title: La Folie Douce Méribel-Courchevel Après-Ski Clubbing
events.summary: High-altitude daily après-ski party at the Saulire mid-station, with the venue’s 2026/27 winter opening period covering all of February 2027 and a format built around dining, entertainment, bar culture, live show energy and DJ-led clubbing.

events.title: Concert de Makash Waloo
events.summary: Makash Waloo, the acoustic duo of Julien Curveur and Mister Martin, plays a late set mixing rock, pop, funk and Latin music. The confirmed February performance runs from 22:00 to 01:00 in Méribel Mottaret.

events.title: Après Live Music with Ben Vickers
events.summary: Ben Vickers plays a solo après-ski set using guitar, vocals and loops, moving through reggae, funk, soul and blues-influenced covers. The confirmed February performance runs from 17:30 to 20:00.

events.title: Concert de Hook
events.summary: Hook, an eclectic rock-covers duo, is confirmed for a late-night Méribel Mottaret performance. The February date runs from 22:00 to 01:00.

events.title: Après Live Music with Flow
events.summary: Flow, aka Florent Loyez, performs a solo après-ski set of pop and rock classics using guitar, vocals and live looping. The confirmed February performance runs from 17:30 to 20:00.

events.title: Open Mic Night – Live Karaoke – Songs on Demand
events.summary: L’Instant Musical leads an interactive open mic and live-karaoke night where the audience chooses from a repertoire of more than 1,000 songs or joins the musicians on stage. The confirmed February session runs from 22:00 to 01:00.

events.title: Après Live Music with Johnny Kisses the Cheerleader
events.summary: Johnny Kisses the Cheerleader performs a solo après-ski set built around rock, pop and reworked classics. The confirmed February performance runs from 17:30 to 20:00.

events.title: Concert de Bacon Juke Box
events.summary: Bacon Juke Box returns to Le Rambler with Russell and Nico for a live set revisiting rock and pop classics from the 1960s to today. The confirmed February performance runs from 22:00 to 01:00.
